mensagens.input: Daryl and Rashad are making paper chains. After 5 minutes, Daryl and Rashad compared the lengths of their chains to see who was working faster. Who built a longer piece of paper chain in 5 minutes?
Daryl's paper chain is 5/6 feet long.
Rashad's  paper chain is 4/5 feet long.
-----,Daryl built the longer paper chain.,Rashad built the longer paper chain.,Both built the same length of paper chain.
Who built a longer piece of paper chain?
